Every CSV upload fails because Windows-generated exports often use CRLF line endings (or BOMs/utf-16/etc. depending on parser implementation), but row parsing or line splitting fails to handle them correctly, causing row 1 column counts to mismatch. Investigation required in CSV parser logic.
